WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT month_start AS month
  FROM calendar_days
  WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
tenant AS (
  SELECT id AS tenant_id FROM tenants WHERE name = 'Cragsley Outfitters'
),
reviews AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', pr.created_at)::date AS month,
         count(*) AS review_count,
         avg(pr.rating) AS avg_rating,
         100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.rating <= 2) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS pct_1_2_star
  FROM product_reviews pr
  JOIN tenant t ON pr.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
  WHERE pr.is_approved = true
  GROUP BY 1
),
orders_agg AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.placed_at)::date AS month,
         count(*) AS orders_count,
         sum(
           CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN o.grand_total
                ELSE o.grand_total / er.rate
           END
         ) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN tenant t ON o.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = o.placed_at::date
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.placed_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  strftime(m.month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  COALESCE(r.review_count, 0) AS review_count,
  ROUND(r.avg_rating::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating,
  ROUND(r.pct_1_2_star::numeric, 1) AS pct_1_2_star,
  COALESCE(oa.orders_count, 0) AS orders_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oa.revenue_eur, 0)::numeric, 0) AS revenue_eur
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.month = m.month
LEFT JOIN orders_agg oa ON oa.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month ASC
note: avg_rating and pct_1_2_star are NULL for months with zero approved reviews (no reviews to average); review_count and orders_count show 0 as requested. EUR-currency orders are passed through at face value, others converted via exchange_rates as of placed_at date.
